offers.requirements:
• 2+ years of experience in Customer Success, account management, or a related customer-facing role.

  • A strong customer-centric mindset and ability to manage a diverse book of Public accounts.

  • Solid communication skills and the ability to engage with operational and mid-senior stakeholders.

  • Comfortable owning the full customer lifecycle — from onboarding through renewal.

  • Strong organizational skills to manage and prioritize multiple accounts effectively.

  • Familiarity with SPICED or similar success planning frameworks is a plus.

  • Fluency in Dutch

What we offer

  • Competitive base salary + holiday allowance, lucrative commission structure and company bonus

  • 25 days annual leave + 4 company-wide cool-down days, your birthday off, and a day off to move house

  • Option to purchase extra holidays

  • Full additional parental leave for partners

  • Flexible working hours (7am–7pm), hybrid working model, and up to 4 months working from abroad

  • Commuter and work-from-home allowance + budget to set up your home office

  • Pension and access to financial advice

  • Annual Body & Mind budget for anything that energises or relaxes you

  • Personal learning budget + extensive internal development opportunities

  • Yearly Summer School & Winter School

  • Annual events: Winter Party, Summer Party & the legendary Big Day

  • A hot lunch made by our in-house chef at our Amsterdam office

  • A week of fun and interactive onboarding to get to know Effectory and your new colleagues

  • A sabbatical once every 5 years

  • A volunteer day to support a cause you care about

This Is How It Works

  1. You want this job — submit your application

  2. We're intrigued — join a phone call to introduce yourself and ask questions

  3. We think it went well — we meet live (or on video) to get to know each other better

  4. We like each other even more — you meet potential team members and get a pleasant grilling

  5. We want to see you in action — you complete a case or assessment (if applicable)

  6. The final hurdle — we agree on terms, sign, and you start

Do you have a high level of self-support, sense of responsibility, initiative, and collaborative spirit? And are you known to use humor or a funny story to lighten the mood? Then you might just be a perfect match with us. We want to be part of creating a more diverse, equitable and inclusive world of work. Even if you don't meet every requirement, we'd still really like to hear from you.

offers.sharing_description: We're looking for a Customer Success Manager to help a broad portfolio of customers in the public sector achieve their desired outcomes, ensuring they maximize the value they get from our products.

en.description:
Effectory is Europe's leading employee feedback solution. With our platform, HR and management collect employee feedback throughout the employee journey. Built on 25 years' experience, our 200 specialists in Amsterdam and Munich support more than 800 organizations in 70+ countries. Our mission: to improve the working world by giving employees a voice and making sure their feedback has an impact.

The role:

We are looking for a Customer Success Manager to help a broad portfolio of customers in the public sector achieve their desired outcomes, ensuring they maximize the value they get from our products and services.

You play a vital role in transforming customers into advocates. It excites you to build and maintain trusted relationships and provide an exquisite customer experience.

You will be joining the team dedicated to the governmental and higher education sector within Effectory. As we service this sector in partnership with the national government, this team holds a high degree of ownership and responsibility to leverage this representative position for knowledge sharing purposes. This also means we develop our own products and services in close collaboration with our partner. This brings its own unique challenges and really requires you to act as the eyes and ears for both the customer and the company.

The salary range for this position is EUR 48.320 and EUR 60.400 gross per year OTE (86% fixed, 14% bonus).

What you’ll be doing:

📈 Own Your Book of Business

Manage ±30-40 customers in the governmental and higher education sector, driving retention and adoption in close collaboration with our consultants.

🚀 Drive Adoption & Engagement

Ensure consistent usage and effect by linking customer goals to our offering. Engage key stakeholders and lead sessions (quarterly reviews) to drive adoption and value.

🤝 Enable Collaboration

Work closely with Consulting, Support, and Onboarding to ensure a seamless customer journey and align on customer needs.

⚡ Manage Risk & Escalations

Handle escalations when needed and proactively mitigate risks to secure successful renewals.

📊 Measure Success

Use SPICED to track outcomes, monitor account health, and run regular check-ins and success reviews (e.g., twice per year).

🔁 Feedback Loop

Represent the voice of the customer internally and share actionable feedback to improve the product and customer experience.

  • Designing and implementing automations using PowerShell, Power Automate, and similar tools.

  • Researching and implementing AI solutions that make internal processes more efficient.

  • Reducing manual work through self-service and automation.

  • Optimizing IT processes based on data and analytics.

  • Maintaining documentation and knowledge bases so that end users can help themselves.

  • Advising on new technologies and innovations.

  • Collaborating with vendors and internal stakeholders.

offers.requirements:
Dit breng je mee

  • Minimaal één jaar ervaring in sales, business development, recruitment, consultancy of een vergelijkbare commerciële rol. 

  • Energie en drive om nieuwe contacten te leggen en de telefoon op te pakken. 

  • Bereidheid om jezelf persoonlijk en professioneel te ontwikkelen. 

  • Nieuwsgierigheid naar organisaties, mensen en HR-vraagstukken. 

  • Doorzettingsvermogen en de bereidheid om te leren van afwijzing. 

  • Heldere manier van communiceren en het vermogen om een bedrijfskundige boodschap relevant te formuleren. 

  • Overzicht en hands on mentaliteit om je eigen pipeline en prioriteiten te beheren. 

  • Interesse in AI-tools en de wil om slimmer te werken zonder de menselijke benadering te verliezen. 

  • Openheid voor directe feedback. 

  • Vloeiend Nederlands; goede beheersing van het Engels is een pluspunt. 

Een afgeronde opleiding vinden we minder belangrijk dan eigenaarschap, leervermogen en commerciële discipline.

Dit zijn wij

Effectory is Europa’s toonaangevende employee feedback-oplossing. Met ons platform helpen we C-level, HR en management om feedback te verzamelen gedurende de hele employee journey. Deze feedback wordt omgezet in people analytics die strategieën ondersteunen om productiviteit, betrokkenheid en retentie te verbeteren. Met 30 jaar ervaring en 200 specialisten in Amsterdam en München ondersteunen we meer dan 800 organisaties in 70+ landen. Meer dan ooit is HR een essentieel onderdeel van de bedrijfsstrategie, daarom is onze oplossing speciaal ontwikkeld voor strategische HR.

Effectory’s missie

Wij zijn toegewijd aan het verbeteren van de werkende wereld door medewerkers een stem te geven en ervoor te zorgen dat hun feedback impact heeft. Onze experts werken wereldwijd met HR-teams en managers om hun grootste people-gerichte uitdagingen aan te pakken. Van software engineers tot HR-specialisten, elke dag werken de mensen van Effectory aan een betere werkende wereld, en we zoeken talent dat deel wil uitmaken van deze missie.

Wat bieden wij? 

  • Competitief salaris en transparant bonus component van 4 maand salarissen OTE oplopend tot 8 maand salarissen bij overperformance.

  • Onboarding traject met coaching, training en begeleiding in je eerste 90 dagen.

  • Een duidelijke groeipad richting Account Executive voor wie daar aantoonbaar klaar voor is.

  • De kans om samen met SDRs en BDRs een outbound team verder vorm te geven.

  • Een ervaren en ambitieus salesteam in het centrum van Amsterdam.

  • 25 vakantiedagen voor FTE’s, 4 Cooldown days (dagen die ons kantoor is gesloten extra bovenop de feestdagen), en flexibele feestdagopties

  • Een leuk en interactief onboardingprogramma om ons bedrijf en je nieuwe collega’s te leren kennen

  • Je komt terecht in een ervaren en ambitieus salesteam waar je dagelijks kunt leren van collega's die weten hoe je succesvol bent. Met intensieve begeleiding, coaching en volop ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen, geef je jouw salescarrière een vliegende (door)start.

  • Een leerbudget voor jouw persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Daarnaast bieden we uitgebreide professionele en persoonlijke ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden

  • Budget om je thuiswerkplek in te richten

  • Jaarlijks Body & Mind-budget voor alles wat jou energie geeft (of ontspant)

  • Jaarlijkse events zoals onze Winter Party, Summer Party & de legendarische Big Day

  • Maandelijkse thuiswerkvergoeding

  • Een laptop en telefoon van de zaak, zodat je direct alles in huis hebt om succesvol te zijn

  • Elke dag een verse, verzorgde lunch op kantoor

  • Een modern kantoor in hartje Amsterdam, uitstekend bereikbaar met het OV

  • Je bent vrij op je verjaardag en krijgt daarnaast een dag om te vrijwilligerswerk te doen voor een doel naar keuze

Zo werkt het

  1. Je wilt deze baan: stuur je sollicitatie via de link hieronder

  2. Wij zijn nieuwsgierig: je hebt een telefoongesprek om jezelf verder voor te stellen en vragen te stellen

  3. Het voelt van beide kanten goed: we ontmoeten elkaar live (of via video) om elkaar beter te leren kennen

  4. We worden nog enthousiaster: je ontmoet potentiële teamleden en krijgt een prettige, inhoudelijke uitdaging

  5. We willen je in actie zien: je rondt een case/assessment af (indien van toepassing)

  6. De laatste stap: we worden het eens over de voorwaarden, we tekenen en jij start!

offers.sharing_description: Start je commerciële carrière als Business Development Representative bij Effectory.

en.description:
Bouw nieuwe pipeline. Ontwikkel jezelf. Groei door.

Ben jij proactief, communicatief supersterk en goed in het creëren van nieuwe kansen?

Als Business Development Representative bij Effectory open je zelf nieuwe deuren bij HR-leiders, people leaders en andere belangrijke stakeholders. Je verdiept je in verschillende organisaties, ontdekt waar kansen liggen en creëert commerciële kansen.

Je krijgt hiervoor een duidelijke lijst met accounts en contacten, waarmee wij in gesprek willen. Bijbehorende data en slimme AI-tools helpen jou in jouw dagelijkse werk. Jij brengt nieuwsgierigheid, eigenaarschap en de drive om te scoren.

Dit is geen rol waarin je alleen inbound leads opvolgt. Je treedt proactief de markt op. Je onderzoekt, belt, schrijft, bezoekt evenementen, experimenteert en krijgt ook regelmatig “nee” te horen. Daar leer en groei je van. Met een uitgestippeld leerpad, coaching, call reviews en een zeer ervaren sales team om je heen om van te leren, stomen we jou in 2 jaar tijd klaar voor de rol van Account Executive. Je bouwt hiermee een robuust trackrecord op dat jou een vliegende start geeft in jouw commerciële loopbaan.

Wat je gaat doen?

  • Je bouwt zelfstandig outbound pipeline op binnen een duidelijk gedefinieerde markt/ segment.

  • Je onderzoekt organisaties, en volgt de laatste trends en ontwikkelingen op het gebied van HR en organisatieontwikkeling.

  • Je benadert prospects proactief via telefoon, e-mail, evenementen, LinkedIn, video en andere kanalen.

  • Je voert inhoudelijke gesprekken met HR-, people-, directie- en business stakeholders.

  • Je ontwikkelt en test verschillende boodschappen en contactstrategieën.

  • Je kwalificeert kansen op probleem, urgentie, relevantie en vervolgstap.

  • Je werkt nauw samen met andere BDRs, Consultants, Account Executives, RevOps en Marketingspecialisten.

  • Je legt je werk zorgvuldig vast in het CRM en deelt marktinzichten met het team.

Wanneer ben je succesvol?

We kijken niet alleen naar je drive en doorzettingsvermogen, maar vooral naar de kwaliteit van je werk en je commerciële slagkracht. Je creëert gesprekken met de juiste mensen, begrijpt wat er bij organisaties speelt en weet een oriënterend gesprek om te zetten in kennismakingsgesprek of demo.

en.description:
As Engineering Manager Platform, you will own the platform function end-to-end: the operating model, internal developer platform, platform investments, team, and outcomes. This is a hands-on leadership role where you will combine people management with active technical contribution to platform architecture, automation, and engineering excellence. You will lead a team of Platform Engineers and SREs (3–4 FTE), working closely with Product, Engineering, Security, and Architecture to enable high-performing software teams across Effectory.

Our ambition is to build a world-class engineering platform that enables teams to deliver software faster, more reliable, and more securely. You will shape the vision, strategy, and roadmap for our Internal Developer Platform (IDP), creating an environment where developers can focus on delivering customer value while platform capabilities provide scalability, reliability, security, and operational excellence by default.

In this role, you will report directly to the CTO

What you’ll be doing: 

Platform strategy & developer experience

  • Define and own the platform engineering strategy and 12-month roadmap, aligned with company objectives and engineering priorities.

  • Drive the evolution of our Internal Developer Platform, making infrastructure, deployment, observability, and security capabilities available through self-service experiences.

  • Continuously improve developer experience by reducing friction, increasing engineering productivity, and simplifying operational tasks.

  • Establish platform standards, golden paths, and engineering practices that promote consistency across teams.

  • Partner with engineering leadership to identify opportunities for platform investments that increase delivery speed, reliability, and quality.

Reliability, operations & cloud infrastructure

  • Own the reliability, availability, and operational excellence of our cloud-native platform.

  • Lead improvements in observability, incident management, resilience, disaster recovery, and service reliability practices.

  • Drive infrastructure modernization initiatives across Azure, Kubernetes, networking, and platform services.

  • Ensure infrastructure and platform services can scale efficiently with business growth and product demands.

  • Champion automation-first approaches to operations and platform management.

Security, compliance & governance

  • Collaborate closely with the CISO to embed security, compliance, and identity management into platform capabilities and engineering workflows.

  • Ensure platform services meet enterprise-grade security and governance requirements.

  • Drive adoption of secure-by-default engineering practices, automated controls, and policy enforcement.

  • Contribute to platform and infrastructure decisions that support Effectory's security and compliance objectives.

Engineering leadership

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Platform Engineers and Site Reliability Engineers.

  • Create a high-performance engineering culture focused on ownership, continuous improvement, learning, and operational excellence.

  • Set clear goals, priorities, and success metrics for the platform team.

  • Support hiring, onboarding, career development, and performance management within the team.

  • Build strong partnerships with Product Managers, Engineering Managers, Tech Leads, and stakeholders across the business.

Architecture & AI-enabled engineering

  • Provide technical leadership on cloud-native architecture, platform design, and engineering enablement.

  • Guide decisions around Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, container platforms, and platform automation.

  • Set the standard for how platform teams leverage AI, automation, and modern engineering tooling to improve productivity and operational efficiency.

  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive operational work and improve platform self-service capabilities.

Hands on platform engineering & technical contribution

  • Act as a senior hands-on contributor within the platform team, regularly participating in the design, implementation, and operation of platform capabilities.

  • Lead by example through direct involvement in platform engineering work, including Infrastructure as Code, cloud architecture, automation, CI/CD, observability, and reliability improvements.

  • Maintain sufficient technical depth and platform expertise to coach engineers effectively and make informed technology decisions.

Platform strategy & developer experience

Reliability, operations & cloud infrastructure

  • Lead improvements in observability, incident management, resilience, disaster recovery, and service reliability practices.

  • Drive infrastructure modernization initiatives across Azure, Kubernetes, networking, and platform services.

  • Ensure infrastructure and platform services can scale efficiently with business growth and product demands.

  • Champion automation-first approaches to operations and platform management.

Security, compliance & governance

  • Collaborate closely with the CISO to embed security, compliance, and identity management into platform capabilities and engineering workflows.

  • Ensure platform services meet enterprise-grade security and governance requirements.

  • Drive adoption of secure-by-default engineering practices, automated controls, and policy enforcement.

  • Contribute to platform and infrastructure decisions that support Effectory's security and compliance objectives.

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Platform Engineers and Site Reliability Engineers.

  • Create a high-performance engineering culture focused on ownership, continuous improvement, learning, and operational excellence.

  • Set clear goals, priorities, and success metrics for the platform team.

  • Support hiring, onboarding, career development, and performance management within the team.

  • Build strong partnerships with Product Managers, Engineering Managers, Tech Leads, and stakeholders across the business.

  • Provide technical leadership on cloud-native architecture, platform design, and engineering enablement.

  • Guide decisions around Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, container platforms, and platform automation.

  • Act as a senior hands-on contributor within the platform team, regularly participating in the design, implementation, and operation of platform capabilities.

en.description:
YOU BRING DATA TO LIFE!

We’re so glad you’re here, because without you, our data and AI foundations simply couldn’t become what we envision. Your work ensures data moves efficiently through resilient systems, powering a platform that’s intelligent, high-performing, and impactful.

As one of our Data / AI Engineers, you’re a core builder of the intelligence behind Effectory. You design, maintain, and evolve the data architecture that fuels our analytics, powers AI features, and helps organizations around the world turn employee feedback into meaningful action.

You work closely with Product Managers, Data Scientists, and Software Engineers, making sure that high-quality data and the AI models built on top of it.  Whether it’s streamlining pipelines, deploying ML models, or automating workflows, you ensure that our platform continues to scale with clarity, trust, and technical excellence.

Your work strengthens Effectory by transforming feedback into insight.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Design, build, and evolve scalable data architecture aligned with business and AI/ML requirements

  • Develop and manage data ingestion pipelines from diverse sources, ensuring data is clean, structured, and ready for analytics or model training

  • Prepare data for AI, ML, and advanced analytics, improving quality, reliability, and accessibility

  • Integrate data from APIs, databases, events and additional internal/external sources

  • Collaborate with Data Scientists to deliver models and AI flows to endpoints, supporting deployment, monitoring, and full lifecycle management

  • Automate workflows using CI/CD, orchestration tools, and modern DevOps/MLOps practices

  • Work closely with Product, Engineering, and Analytics teams to translate business needs into technical solutions

  • Deploy and monitor pipelines and models using cloud-native tools (Azure preferred)

  • Provide documentation, support, and guidance to internal stakeholders and customers

  • Continuously improve our tools, workflows, and architecture

  • Stay current with emerging data and AI technologies and best practices

  • Work in an agile, cross-functional environment aligned with company OKRs

  • Take ownership of technical decisions and their impact on our product and platform
